mapper.update: UPDATE stored_file SET status = 1, ref_type = #{refType}, ref_id = #{refId}, bind_time = COALESCE(bind_time, #{now}), update_time = #{now} WHERE file_name = #{fileName} AND ( (status = 0 AND uploader_id = #{uploaderId}) OR (status = 1 AND ref_type = #{refType} AND ref_id = #{refId}) )
UPDATE stored_file SET status = 3, ref_type = NULL, ref_id = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE file_name = #{fileName} AND status IN (0, 2)

UPDATE stored_file SET status = 3, ref_type = NULL, ref_id = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE file_name = #{fileName} AND ( status = 2 OR (status = 0 AND create_time < #{temporaryCutoff}) OR (status = 3 AND update_time < #{deletingLeaseCutoff}) )

FROM stored_file sf WHERE sf.status = 2 OR (sf.status = 0 AND sf.create_time < #{temporaryCutoff}) OR (sf.status = 3 AND sf.update_time < #{deletingLeaseCutoff}) ORDER BY sf.status DESC, sf.update_time ASC, sf.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
